Criterion: Verify that in-flight egress, ground emergency egress, and assisted egress of any crewmember or passenger are not affected when the aerial refueling system cannot be returned to its fully stowed configuration. Standard: In-flight egress, ground emergency egress, and assisted egress of any crewmember or passenger are not hindered when the aerial refueling system cannot be returned to its fully stowed configuration (see also 9.1.2 of this document). Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, demonstration and review of documentation. Analyses and demonstration verify in-flight egress, ground emergency egress, and assisted egress of any crewmember or passenger are not hindered when the aerial refueling system cannot be returned to its fully stowed configuration References: JSSG-2009: F.3.4.6.1.1, F.4.4.6.1.1; F.3.4.6.1.2, F.4.4.6.1.2 MIL-HDBK-516: 9 14 CFR 25.1309
